content:
为 [**奇幻家具**](https://modrinth.com/mod/fantasy-furniture) 添加了**北欧**风格家具套装，包含完全可交互的家具，包括但不限于：**箱子**、**抽屉**、**床**、**座椅**等！ 该家具套装的设计深受**《上古卷轴Online》**与**《天际》**的启发。
若要合成**北欧木板**/**北欧羊毛**，需使用 **#minecraft:planks**/**#minecraft:wool**。 ![planks-stonecutter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ApexStudios-Dev/.github/refs/heads/master/assets/minecraft/fantasyfurniture_nordic/stonecutter_planks.png) ![wool-stonecutter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ApexStudios-Dev/.github/refs/heads/master/assets/minecraft/fantasyfurniture_nordic/stonecutter_wool.png) 若要合成**北欧**家具方块，需将 **#fantasyfurniture:binding_agent**、**北欧木板**和**北欧羊毛**放入**家具工作台**中合成。 ![furniture-station](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ApexStudios-Dev/.github/refs/heads/master/assets/minecraft/fantasyfurniture_nordic/furniture_station.png)
